title: Unadmitted observation worker polls SQLite every 100 ms without bound while a report's image is not durable
outcome: While a report's exact session-row image cannot be stored, the observation worker waits with bounded, backed-off polling or parks until a persist or shutdown wakes it. It no longer re-reads SQLite every 100 ms for as long as the process lives. Nothing is sent before the image is durable, as before.
acceptance: While a pending report's image is not durable, the worker neither sends a request nor re-reads the session row at a fixed 100 ms interval indefinitely: the wait backs off or parks, and a later successful persist or shutdown ends it
A focused test pins that no request leaves before the image is stored and that the worker resumes delivery after the image becomes durable
The worker still reports idle only when no deliverable or capture work remains
